notes: Representative human-reviewed subset of EDPB Guidelines 01/2022 on data subject rights - right of access, consultation version 1.0 (18 January 2022) -> final adopted version (v2.x, after public consultation). The sampled changes were reviewed directly against the extracted text of both PDFs and correspond to documented post-consultation edits: removal of the consultation watermark, expanded completeness wording around providing a copy, a changed qualification of whether an exception affects confirmation of processing, and footnote/citation reflow.

changes.note: The consultation watermark no longer appears on every page of the final version.

changes.new_quote: which includes all information necessary to enable the data subject to understand and verify the lawfulness of the processing
changes.note: Paragraph 23 area: final text adds an explicit completeness clause when providing a copy.

changes.old_quote: will mostly not be affected by the exception
changes.new_quote: may not be affected by the exception
changes.note: The final text changes the qualification of whether the exception affects confirmation of processing.
